synthesis:draft.headline: Meaning of operational demand
summary: Operational demand in a region is demand met by local scheduled, semi-scheduled and significant non-scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region, excluding the demand of local scheduled loads and scheduled bidirectional units, and including Wholesale Demand Response. [aemo_demand_terms#p9c11]
Operational demand generally excludes demand met by small non-scheduled wind and solar generation, other non-scheduled generation, and exempt generation. [aemo_demand_terms#p10c14]

Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with an estimate of actual Wholesale Demand Response, and AEMO may make retroactive adjustments to operational demand. [aemo_demand_terms#p10c15]
Operational demand is used for public reporting of market and power system operation and in forecast processes such as pre-dispatch and PASA products. [aemo_demand_terms#p11c17]

possible_explanations.statement: Operational demand may exclude small non-scheduled wind and solar units because those units are not modelled as part of operational demand in the EMMS (see aemo_demand_terms#p10c14).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the EMMS classification and inclusion rules for non-scheduled renewable units against the measured outputs and the published operational demand time series to see whether and how those units are omitted.

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO might reconstitute measured operational demand with estimated Wholesale Demand Response so that historical measured values and forecasts align (see aemo_demand_terms#p10c15).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve the measured operational demand field, the WDR_ESTIMATE field and pre-dispatch forecasts for the same intervals and compare the sums to confirm the reconstitution process.

citations.quote: Operational demand in a region is demand that is met by local scheduled 6, semi-scheduled7 and significant non-scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region, excluding the demand of local scheduled loads10 and scheduled bidirectional units, and including Wholesale Demand Response.

Operational demand differs from native demand in that it generally excludes demand met by non- scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar generation and exempt generation.
Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual WDR.
citations.supports: how measured operational demand is adjusted to include Wholesale Demand Response

citations.quote: For public reporting of electricity market and power system operation: for example, the minimum and maximum measured operational demand records reported to the media for reporting on market and power system incidents.

uncertainties: The retrieved passages are general EMMS definitions and not region specific; local implementation details or region exceptions may exist.

Numeric thresholds referenced in the passages (for example the capacity threshold mentioned in the quoted text) are present in the retrieved text but the retrieval did not provide evidence_ids tied to those numeric values.
